[Unit]
Description=Qisutu Automation and Mail Daemon (qisutu)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=qisutu
Group=www-data
WorkingDirectory=/opt/qisutu
Environment=QISUTU_HOME=/opt/qisutu
ExecStart=/usr/bin/perl /opt/qisutu/bin/qisutu-daemon.pl --sleep 3 --max-jobs 100
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=120
KillSignal=SIGTERM
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
---TEMP UNITS---
qisutu-daemon.service
---USER---
uid=999(qisutu) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)
---PERL MODULES---
Perl modules OK: Authen::SASL, Net::LDAP, DBI
---BOOTSTRAP---
installed.lock
installer-operation.lock
instance.conf

observation.command: cat /etc/systemd/system/qisutu-daemon.service; echo '---TEMP UNITS---'; ls /etc/systemd/system/ | grep -i qisutu; echo '---USER---'; id qisutu; echo '---PERL MODULES---'; perl -MAuthen::SASL -MNet::LDAP -MDBI -e 'print "Perl modules OK: Authen::SASL, Net::LDAP, DBI\n"' 2>&1; echo '---BOOTSTRAP---'; ls /opt/qisutu/var/install/; mysql -u root -e "SELECT user,host FROM mysql.user;" 2>&1
